source_policies.name: arXiv
source_policies.access_method: Public abstract pages and public API
source_policies.full_text_boundary: Preprints are publicly readable when present; reuse remains governed by the license shown on each record.
source_policies.license_boundary: Use metadata and short abstract evidence for this benchmark; inspect each record license before redistributing full text.
source_policies.rate_limit_policy: The verified public pages do not freeze a numeric production quota; D-02 must recheck official API terms, serialize requests, and back off on provider errors.
source_policies.public_runtime_risk: Public availability does not guarantee production latency or uninterrupted access, and versions may differ from the journal version.

source_policies.name: Crossref REST API
source_policies.access_method: Public or polite REST metadata API
source_policies.full_text_boundary: Crossref supplies deposited metadata and links, not a general entitlement to article full text.
source_policies.license_boundary: Metadata may be retrieved publicly; linked content remains governed by the publisher or repository license.
source_policies.rate_limit_policy: As verified on 2026-07-19, public access is limited to 5 requests per interval with concurrency 1 and polite access to 10 with concurrency 3; clients must honor response headers and 429 backoff.
source_policies.public_runtime_risk: Deposited metadata may be incomplete or updated, and production integrations must identify themselves and cache responsibly.

source_policies.name: NASA Astrophysics Data System
source_policies.access_method: Developer API for bibliographic search and metadata
source_policies.full_text_boundary: ADS links to provider copies; it does not grant access beyond the linked provider's rights.
source_policies.license_boundary: Abstract copyright and linked full-text rights are record-specific and must be preserved.
source_policies.rate_limit_policy: The verified standard API policy states 5000 regular requests per day for most request types; a token is required and enhanced limits require approval.
source_policies.public_runtime_risk: A secret token is required for API use, quotas apply, and the service must never be called directly from the frontend.

source_policies.name: NASA Technical Reports Server
source_policies.full_text_boundary: Only files explicitly exposed by an NTRS record may be opened; the record does not grant access to unavailable publisher content.
source_policies.license_boundary: Honor the rights and availability notice on each record; NASA hosting alone is not treated as a blanket redistribution license.
source_policies.rate_limit_policy: No numeric automated-use quota is frozen by D-01; these pages are verification records, and D-02 must obtain and honor current service guidance before automation.
source_policies.public_runtime_risk: Record pages may change or omit files, so production retrieval must not depend on this benchmark verification path without a separately approved adapter.

source_policies.name: Caltech/IPAC Publication Record
source_policies.full_text_boundary: The institutional record verifies bibliographic metadata and links; linked full text remains subject to the repository or publisher access boundary.
source_policies.license_boundary: Use the record for verification and follow the rights stated by each linked content provider; do not infer a full-text reuse license.
source_policies.rate_limit_policy: No numeric automated-use quota is frozen by D-01; use is limited to benchmark verification unless a later Issue approves and revalidates an adapter policy.
source_policies.public_runtime_risk: The publication page is not a committed production API and may change structure or linked availability.

search_scenarios.purpose: Recover the mission, target-catalog, revised-catalog, and prime-mission TOI references used by the fixed case.

query.query_string: (TESS OR "Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite") AND ("Input Catalog" OR "Objects of Interest" OR "nearby bright stars")

search_scenarios.dedupe_expectation: Group records by normalized DOI first, then arXiv id, then normalized title and publication year; retain every source record and conflict.
search_scenarios.ranking_expectation: Rank exact title and identifier matches before topical matches; prefer records directly describing TESS mission, TIC/CTL, or TOI catalog scope.

search_scenarios.purpose: Recover references that connect exoplanet records to host-star properties and archive provenance.

query.query_string: (TESS AND "host stars" AND (mass OR radius OR metallicity)) OR "NASA Exoplanet Archive"

search_scenarios.dedupe_expectation: Use DOI/arXiv/title-year canonicalization and keep publisher, repository, and preprint records as provenance for one paper identity.
search_scenarios.ranking_expectation: Prefer papers that explicitly expose archive contents or quantify how host-star parameters affect TESS planet candidates.

seed_papers.title: Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite
seed_papers.license_or_usage_boundary: The publisher record identifies an open Creative Commons version; this package stores only metadata and short abstract evidence.
seed_papers.rate_limit_or_runtime_risk: Publisher and arXiv availability are external; D-02 must use provider-specific backoff and must not depend on this seed as a fallback search result.

seed_papers.title: The TESS Input Catalog and Candidate Target List
seed_papers.license_or_usage_boundary: The arXiv preprint is readable; publisher copyright and repository terms remain applicable to redistribution.
seed_papers.rate_limit_or_runtime_risk: The benchmark pins identifiers and short evidence only; a future adapter must not assume publisher full text is freely reusable.

seed_papers.title: The Revised TESS Input Catalog and Candidate Target List
seed_papers.license_or_usage_boundary: Use the open preprint or explicitly public repository copy; do not infer publisher reuse rights from metadata availability.
seed_papers.rate_limit_or_runtime_risk: TIC versions evolve, so downstream runs must pin the paper and catalog version rather than resolve a dynamic latest record.

seed_papers.title: The TESS Objects of Interest Catalog from the TESS Prime Mission
seed_papers.license_or_usage_boundary: The public preprint and repository copies may be read; this package retains only metadata and short abstract evidence.
seed_papers.rate_limit_or_runtime_risk: The TOI catalog is time-scoped to the prime mission and must not be treated as a current complete catalog.

seed_papers.title: The NASA Exoplanet Archive: Data and Tools for Exoplanet Research
seed_papers.license_or_usage_boundary: The preprint is public, while archive data and linked literature retain their own source and license requirements.
seed_papers.rate_limit_or_runtime_risk: The 2013 paper describes historical archive contents; it cannot prove current tables, fields, or availability without current source snapshots.

seed_papers.title: The GALAH Survey: Using Galactic Archaeology to Refine our Knowledge of TESS Target Stars
seed_papers.license_or_usage_boundary: The arXiv preprint is readable; reuse of the journal version remains governed by the publisher.
seed_papers.rate_limit_or_runtime_risk: The cross-matched sample is survey- and release-specific and must not be generalized to every TESS host star.

paper_summaries.research_goal: Establish the TESS mission scope relevant to nearby bright host stars.

method.text: The mission uses transit photometry of bright and nearby stars.

findings.text: The paper states a pre-launch expectation of more than one thousand planets smaller than Neptune.

limitations.text: The quoted yield is an expectation, not an observed prime-mission catalog result.

paper_summaries.research_goal: Capture the initial TIC and CTL construction and its selection limits.

method.text: The authors assembled catalogs and algorithms for the TIC and ranked stars for the CTL.

findings.text: Target prioritization is tied to the smallest transiting planet detectable.

limitations.text: Additional factors affect photometric detection and dynamic confirmation of small planets.

paper_summaries.research_goal: Capture how TIC-8 revised the target catalog with Gaia DR2.

method.text: The revised TIC incorporates Gaia DR2 and uses a revised target ranking system.

findings.text: The paper explicitly presents the catalog and ranking as revisions of the earlier TIC and CTL.

limitations.text: The abstract supports catalog construction and ranking claims, not realized planet-yield claims.

paper_summaries.research_goal: Capture the scope and status of prime-mission TOI candidates.

dataset.text: The TOI catalog contains 2,241 candidates identified from the two-year TESS prime mission.

findings.text: Prime-mission TOI catalog and related TESS data products are publicly available through MAST.

limitations.text: The 2,241 records are candidates and include previously known planets, so they are not equivalent to newly confirmed planets.

paper_summaries.research_goal: Capture why host-star properties matter and how GALAH, TIC, and Gaia were aligned.

method.text: The study cross-matched GALAH DR2, TIC, and Gaia DR2 data.

dataset.text: The cross-match produced a catalog of physical and chemical properties for 47,285 stars.

findings.text: Exoplanet mass and radius estimates depend strongly on measured host-star properties.

limitations.text: The reported cross-match is a release-specific sample and does not cover every TESS host star.
